versions.changelog:
Initial release: bundle multiple Markdown files into a standalone, offline HTML browser.

- Packages all Markdown files in a directory into a single HTML file with built-in GFM renderer.
- Features a real expandable/collapsible directory tree, global full-text search, auto-generated TOC, and dark mode.
- Supports offline viewing—no server or CDN required; open with any browser.
- Cross-document `.md` links work automatically; content is lazily rendered for large doc sets.
- Optional YAML config for grouping, ordering, icons, and status badges.
- Auto-categorizes files when no config is provided; efficiently handles 100+ files.
